summary: Manage workspace knowledge files and libraries in the Cargo content domain — upload, list, rename, move, and remove files (PDFs, CSVs, text), and create or sync native and connector-backed libraries for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Use when the user wants to upload or organize knowledge files, build a knowledge library, or sync an external knowledge source. To attach these to an agent, use the cargo-ai skill.
